notes: Sanitizes Qt plugin and font environment variables before launching the standalone updater window.
Prevents OpenCV/cv2 Qt plugin paths from being inherited by the PySide6 updater process.
Keeps display and desktop session variables available so the updater window can still attach to the Pi desktop.
Adds the same defensive Qt environment cleanup inside the updater backend before importing the GUI window.
Keeps update, rollback, offline bundle, firmware, device protocol, motion, and pressure-control behavior unchanged.
summary: Fixes updater window startup when OpenCV Qt plugin paths are present in the app environment.
validation: Get-ChildItem releases\*.json | ForEach-Object { Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null }
